claims: New candidates require an authentic latest non-superseded ACTIVE entry whose trusted introduction is an ancestor of or equal to candidate.base_commit.
The authority commit and every commit reachable from base but not authority are compared with every parent and must change no allowed-scope path.
The linear base-to-head touched-path set equals the declared artifact and evidence path set, and every declared head blob differs from its base blob.
Merged stale artifacts, merged hidden helpers, add-delete prehistory, authority-bundled content, undeclared candidate helpers, and changed-then-restored outputs refuse mechanically.

Only the exact fifteen COMPLETE candidate snapshots at ledger prefix 240 are grandfathered, allowing solely ELIGIBLE to INTEGRATED state progression; broadened CC-000 and provisional CC-021 objects are not legacy.
Quiet Bell candidate remains NONE, Small Shop supplies process learning only, and Quiet Bell then Greenhouse then compiler edge cases remains the execution order.
limitations: This verifies repository governance against trusted HEAD, not external attestation, remote identity, or information-flow security.
This creates no oracle content, candidate, compiler semantic, runtime, fixture, package, release, selection, or public contract.
OVR-000244 must be committed before its trusted introduction can become the practical base for future Quiet Bell content.

summary: Verify strict clean-base candidate admission and exact legacy freeze.
why: The hardening report and OVR-000242 prove that allowed-scope bytes cannot enter before the declared candidate range, that candidate commits contain only declared outputs and evidence, and that legacy admission is closed over exact prefix-240 snapshots rather than a broad bootstrap or historical exception.
